body:
# AnyVanillaWaterlog

Ever wished more blocks in Minecraft could be waterlogged?

AnyVanillaWaterlog expands the vanilla waterlogging system, allowing many more blocks to contain water just like stairs, slabs, and fences normally do.

This makes building underwater structures, decorative fountains, aquariums, and detailed builds much easier without needing complicated tricks.

## Features

• Waterlog many vanilla blocks that normally can't contain water  
• Works with Minecraft's vanilla fluid mechanics  
• Improves building possibilities for underwater and decorative builds  
• Lightweight and designed to feel like a natural extension of vanilla

## Technical Details

The mod modifies how water interacts with blocks, allowing additional blocks to support waterlogging while keeping compatibility with Minecraft’s fluid update system.

## Use Cases

• Underwater bases  
• Decorative builds with water inside blocks  
• Aquariums and fountains  
• More flexible building with water mechanics

## Compatibility

Designed to stay close to vanilla behavior while expanding what blocks can hold water.

---

If you encounter bugs or visual issues related to water updates, please report them.
